name: Lost Winter Nights
source:
Another winter passes, with nothing changing.

Ethan Wright is a 20 year old college student who lives a normal, satisfying life.

With his four best friends, he can't think of anything more he needs.

But something is wrong. An unshakable feeling that something important is missing.

Until, one night, he meets a strange girl, sitting in the falling snow.

As weeks pass, Ethan will learn that his life isn't as quite right as he thought and will inevitably get closer and closer to the truth.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=34216]Lemmasoft forums[/url]]
translation:
又一个冬天过去了，什么都没有改变。

伊森·赖特是一名20岁的大学生，过着普通而满足的生活。

和四位最要好的朋友在一起，他想不到自己还需要什么。

但有些事情不对劲。他始终感觉自己缺少某件重要的东西。

直到某个夜晚，他遇见了一名坐在飘落雪花中的奇怪女孩。

随着几周过去，伊森会发现自己的人生并不像想象中那么正常，并不可避免地一步步接近真相。
